name: Jülide Kahkeci
role: POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCH FELLOW · UNIVERSITY OF ALBERTA
subtitle: Environmental Engineer · Water & Wastewater Treatment Researcher
intro: I work at the intersection of photocatalysis, adsorption, and engineered treatment systems for water and wastewater applications. My research focuses on sustainable solutions for emerging contaminants, stormwater, municipal effluents, and oil sands process-affected water.
about_paragraph_1: I am a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the University of Alberta, where I work on water and wastewater treatment research. I hold a PhD in Environmental Engineering from the University of Alberta, an MSc in Materials Science and Nanotechnology from Bilkent University, and a BSc in Chemical Engineering from Middle East Technical University.
about_paragraph_2: My research interests lie at the intersection of advanced oxidation processes, adsorbent materials, and applied environmental engineering. I develop biochar-supported photocatalysts, investigate contaminant removal and toxicity in real water matrices, and work on nature-based and pilot-scale systems for practical treatment applications.
